facts.text: In Great Britain, the Health and Safety Executive (HSE) enforces workplace safety, the Supply of Machinery (Safety) Regulations 2008 govern which machines may be sold, and UKCA is the British conformity mark that replaced CE marking after the United Kingdom left the European Union.
facts.quote: In Great Britain the Health and Safety Executive (HSE) enforces workplace safety, the Supply of Machinery (Safety) Regulations 2008 govern what machines may be sold, and UKCA is the British conformity mark

facts.text: Great Britain retained its existing European machinery law; the Supply of Machinery (Safety) Regulations 2008 (SI 2008/1597), as amended, impose general essential health and safety requirements and conformity obligations.
facts.quote: Great Britain kept the European machinery law it already had. The Supply of Machinery (Safety) Regulations 2008 (SI 2008/1597), as amended, impose general essential health and safety requirements and conformity obligations

facts.text: Amendments to Great Britain's machinery regulations in SI 2026/867 take effect on 20 January 2027, the same day the EU's new Machinery Regulation applies.
facts.quote: amendments in SI 2026/867 take effect on 20 January 2027, the day the EU's new Machinery Regulation applies

facts.text: Britain uses designated standards in place of harmonized standards; the notice of 8 August 2026 designated the EN 474:2022 earth-moving machinery family.
facts.quote: In place of harmonized standards Britain has "designated standards"; the notice of 8 August 2026 designated the EN 474:2022 earth-moving machinery family.

facts.text: The booklet found no dedicated off-road automatic-braking regime and no UK collision-avoidance mandate.
facts.quote: No dedicated off-road automatic-braking regime and "no UK collision-avoidance mandate" were found

facts.text: EU product law applies in Northern Ireland under the Windsor Framework, so a single declaration route should not be assumed to cover both Great Britain and Northern Ireland.
facts.quote: Northern Ireland is different: under the Windsor Framework EU product law applies there, so one declaration route should not be assumed to cover both

facts.text: UKCA means UK Conformity Assessed and is placed on products sold in Great Britain to declare compliance; UKCA corresponds to CE marking, and British approved bodies correspond to notified bodies.
facts.quote: UKCA (UK Conformity Assessed) is the mark placed on a product sold in Great Britain to declare compliance, the counterpart of the CE mark, with "approved bodies" as the counterpart of notified bodies.

facts.text: For the collision-mitigation program, Britain adds a second, parallel declaration path and a separate standards-designation calendar.
facts.quote: Britain adds a second declaration, a separate standards-designation calendar

facts.text: The Health and Safety Executive is Britain's workplace regulator, inspecting sites and prosecuting after accidents.
facts.quote: The HSE is the workplace regulator that inspects sites and prosecutes after accidents.

facts.text: HSE statistics report that 126 workers were killed in Great Britain in 2025/26.
facts.quote: in 2025/26, 126 workers were killed in Great Britain

facts.text: Being struck by a moving vehicle was the second most common cause of worker death in Great Britain in 2025/26, with 24 deaths, according to HSE statistics.
facts.quote: being struck by a moving vehicle was the second most common cause with 24 deaths

facts.text: HSE workplace transport guidance states that nearly a quarter of all deaths involving workplace transport occur during reversing.
facts.quote: nearly a quarter of all deaths involving Workplace transport occur during reversing

facts.text: HSE quarry guidance states that transport accounts for 40% of all accidents in quarries and 60% of all deaths.
facts.quote: transport accounts for 40% of all accidents in quarries and 60% of all deaths

facts.text: The Quarries Regulations 1999 and HSE quarry guidance documents were not verified in the booklet.
facts.quote: The Quarries Regulations 1999 and HSE's quarry guidance documents were not verified

facts.text: HSE figures form part of the booklet's evidence that reversing and workplace transport dominate the harm the collision mitigation system is intended to prevent.
facts.quote: HSE's figures are part of the evidence that reversing and workplace transport dominate the harm the system is meant to prevent
